name: staff-emergency-contact-contract-fix
title: Fix staff emergency contact create contract
description: Align the add/edit employee GraphQL contract with the Staff emergencyContacts persistence model and expose the primary contact to the current UI.
creator: LQVCohan
notes: Fixed the full emergency-contact contract: CreateUserInput now accepts the singular UI field; the modal omits it when all values are blank; the staff resolver maps it to the model's emergencyContacts array on create/update while preserving secondary contacts; and the private DTO exposes the primary contact back to the UI. Added schema, resolver, and DTO regression coverage. Verification was performed by re-fetching the committed files; automated tests were not run because this connector workspace has no runnable repository checkout.
